other_states_note.pro_bono_list: Organized by immigration court location inside each state (Colorado: Aurora and Denver). Only states with an immigration court have a section. Each court section lists the providers for that court, plus referral services that repeat across courts. Cover page says updated quarterly.
other_states_note.roster: Organized by state, then city. Lists recognized organizations; individual accredited representatives are in separate lists.
other_states_note.build_rule: Same ingest per state: read both official files, quote, never add a provider that is not on them, keep the as-of dates.
